tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Every panel the player reads: dialogue box, price board, tray, money row, chips, receipt, journal. Rice paper by morning, lantern-lit tea wood by evening.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things picked up inside a panel: item tiles and money buttons. One step off the card, no border.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Round secondary controls, such as the replay button, always with a hairline ring.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells and pressed states: a pressed word token, the next-customer avatar disc, the stage behind panels in previews.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px ring around every panel and chip, the underline under a word token, chip dividers.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed rules: the receipt rule, the outline of a tray tile whose item is already on the counter.

tokens.name: slot-edge
tokens.usage: Dashed edge of an empty slot the player must fill, such as 找零. The one edge strong enough to read as a place to put something.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: All Chinese the player must read: spoken lines, item names, prices, totals. Also the fill of the single primary button, 继续.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Speaker labels, 下一位, word counts, the name under a placed tile, and every icon stroke.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Only for text 24px and larger or for non-text marks; 4.4:1 on card by morning, so never for text under 24px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The vermilion of a shop chop, parent of word-marker, chop and accent-ink. Touches words only: never a control, a tick, a state or a correct answer.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Vermilion as characters under 24px, such as a new word's headword in the 本子. 6.4:1 on card by morning.

tokens.name: word-marker
tokens.usage: The dot over a new word, such as 馒头: 8px on desktop, 6px on phone, centred on the token's top edge.

tokens.name: chop
tokens.usage: Border and characters of the 多谢 chop that confirms an order on the receipt.

tokens.name: jade
tokens.usage: Scene only: a hairpin, a bowl glaze, a plant. Never UI and never success.

tokens.name: steam
tokens.usage: Scene only: the steam loop over the steamers and bowls. Takes the lantern's warmth by evening.

tokens.name: window-cool
tokens.usage: Scene only: the cold street through the window, the one cool note against the dough tones. Dusk indigo by evening.

tokens.name: lamp-glow
tokens.usage: Scene only: the radial glow of the hanging lamp by morning and the lanterns by evening, at about 40% opacity, kept inside the stall.

families.sans: "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Phone only: the value printed on a coin. Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Desktop 找零 slot; phone chips, speaker label, receipt lines and tile names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Desktop tile names, receipt lines, chip text, speaker label (at 500). Tabular figures wherever a number appears.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The receipt total 共 4块 on desktop; the largest interface size.

styles.name: spoken
styles.usage: The customer's line on desktop, set as word tokens.

styles.name: spoken-compact
styles.usage: The customer's line on phone. Nothing spoken is ever set under 28px.

styles.name: board
styles.usage: Price board names and prices, tabular figures. Phone tightens the line height to 28px.

styles.name: seal
styles.usage: The 多谢 chop, set vertically. 14px inside the phone's smaller chop.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a stack of receipt lines; gap between speaker label and line on phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tray and money padding, gap between tiles, between an icon and its word, between the two dialogue buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Chip side padding; phone receipt and price board padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Receipt and price board padding on desktop; the phone's screen edge and dialogue padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: The gutter: screen edge to panel on desktop, dialogue padding top and bottom, gap between the line and its buttons.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Dialogue padding left and right on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Section gaps in the journal and the day tally; never inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Dialogue box, price board, tray, money row.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Day, next-customer and journal chips.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Item tiles, money buttons, the 找零 slot.

tokens.name: radius-receipt
tokens.usage: The receipt slip and the top corners of a word token. Paper, nearly square.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The one shadow: every panel and the receipt, always paired with a 1px hairline ring.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Chips only, which sit flat on the beam; paired with a 1px hairline ring.
